title: Ideal inertia cardinality equals the ramification index in a finite Galois number field
statement: Let Ω = AlgebraicClosure ℚ and let E be a finite-dimensional Galois intermediate field of Ω/ℚ. Let q be a natural prime, put O = NumberField.RingOfIntegers E, and let P be a prime ideal of O whose contraction to ℤ is (q). Under the canonical action of G = Gal(E/ℚ) on O, let I = {σ ∈ G : σ(a) − a ∈ P for every a ∈ O}. Then Nat.card I = Ideal.ramificationIdx P ℤ.
lean_statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [IsGalois ℚ E] (q : ℕ), q.Prime → ∀ P : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers E), P.IsPrime → P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)}) → Nat.card (P.inertia (E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E)) = Ideal.ramificationIdx P ℤ
